title: Nobody talks to Kubernetes directly. Meet the gatekeeper
caption: The kube-apiserver is the unsung brain of your cluster. Have you ever checked its logs?

scenes.vo: Nobody touches your cluster directly. Every single command must pass through one gatekeeper: the kube-apiserver.
scenes.heading: API SERVER

scenes.vo: Think of it like a strict bouncer. It authenticates who you are and decides if you are allowed inside.
scenes.heading: THE BOUNCER

scenes.vo: When you apply a pod, it validates your token, checks policy, and writes into etcd. It is the only component allowed to talk to the database.
scenes.heading: REQUEST PIPELINE

scenes.vo: Forget the idea that Kubernetes is a magic black box. You can see the apiserver running as a static pod inside kube-system.
scenes.heading: SEE IT RUNNING

scenes.vo: Remember: it is your front door, authenticates everything, and solely guards the database. Follow for more Kubernetes made simple!
scenes.heading: API SERVER
